serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
#Landlord.Misc.money
He snatched the money and counted it.
Landlord: You’re 100$ short.
You: Are you sure? I counted it a few times.
#Landlord.Face.Unhappy
Landlord: WHO DO YOU TAKE ME FOR! OF COURSE I’M SURE!
You: Can you… count again?
Landlord: …
Landlord: Anon, Anon, Anon. My dear Anon…
Landlord: I will do it, but if I count again and it turns out you gave me the wrong amount, you owe me an additional 500$, because of the time I wasted here.
You: That’s completely unreasonable!!!
He quickly flipped through the stack of money again.
#Landlord.Face.Surprised
Landlord: Wha…
Landlord: …
His face showed some emotion. That's rare.
He looks... shocked?
Landlord: I…
Landlord: It’s…
Landlord: It’s…{{wi}} the…{{wi}} correct…{{wi}} amount…
You: Oh, so you just made a mistake counting money?
Landlord: “just made a mistake counting money”? 
Landlord: …
He seemed shaken by the news.
Landlord: Anon… 
You: Yes?
#Landlord.Face.Grin
Landlord: I got you! Hehehehe~
#Landlord.animate(TransparencyTo0,0.5)
He left before I could even say goodbye. 
Did he really make a mistake or was it an elaborate prank? I don’t take him for a person to make jokes like this.
I guess even someone like him slips up sometimes.
That was really uncharacteristic of him. Especially because money was involved.
